v23-5.candidate: For is not my house so with the Mighty One? For He established an everlasting covenant with me, ready at every time, guarded; for all my salvation and every desire—surely the lawless one will not sprout.
v23-5.display:
For is not my house so with the Mighty One? For He established an everlasting covenant with me, ready at every time, guarded;
for all my salvation and every desire—surely the lawless one will not sprout.

v23-8.candidate: These are the names of David’s mighty men: Jebosthe the Canaanite is chief of the third, Adinon the Asonite. He drew his sword against eight hundred wounded men at one time.

v23-10.candidate: but he stood and struck the foreigners until his hand grew weary and clung to the sword. The Lord brought about a great deliverance that day; the people sat behind him, except to strip the foreigners.

v23-18.candidate: Abishai, Joab’s brother, son of Zeruiah, was chief among the three. He raised his spear against three hundred wounded men, and he had a name among the three.
